environment.description: EKS pod running in namespace 'data-plane' with default network policies. Pod spec drops CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN but retains all other capabilities. JWKS endpoint is accessible from the pod. The gRPC port 50051 is exposed via a Kubernetes Service of type ClusterIP with no ingress restrictions within the cluster. Any pod in the cluster can reach this service. The JWKS public keys are cached and also available at the well-known endpoint accessible to any authenticated cluster entity.
